title: Anoikis findings register
description: The effort's ranked feedback register, at Layout.Findings() (findings.json). This is the on-disk shape ai-shared-lib's go/ledger package already reads and writes (schema "ledger@1.0.0") — internal/findings is a thin composition over it, so this contract documents that shape rather than defining a new one. The version tag lives on the field named schema, not schema_version, because it is the ledger library's own tag and this file stays faithful to bytes already on disk; a document declaring any other value is refused rather than read with guessed semantics. Never confuse this with review-findings.schema.json: that is a review's one-shot output, this is the engine's durable state, and the two must never share a path.

citation.description: The evidence behind a resolution: a located line, a released tag, a task id — or, on an unresolved entry, the zero value.

retraction.description: Populated only once resolution is retracted; the zero value otherwise.
